Based on the task prompt, I need to identify which tropical rainforest represents a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth and comprises one of the largest and most biodiverse tracts of tropical rainforest in the world.

The answer is the **Amazon Rainforest** (also known as Amazonia or the Amazon Jungle).

The Amazon Rainforest:
- Covers approximately 5.5 million square kilometers (2.1 million square miles)
- Represents about 25% (a quarter) of the world's remaining tropical forests
- Is the largest tropical rainforest in the world
- Contains the highest biodiversity of any terrestrial ecosystem on Earth, with an estimated 10% of all known species found there
- Spans nine countries in South America, with the majority (about 60%) located in Brazil
